name: path-privacy
description: Keeps personal identifiers out of repo content: every path written into the repo must be relative to the repo root, and the git user.name full name never appears. PreToolUse hooks rewrite in-repo absolute paths to relative and block external paths or full-name leaks across file edits and git/gh commands; pre-commit and commit-msg git hooks hard-block at commit.
suggestedPrompts: Scan this repository for leaked external paths or full-name occurrences
Install the path-privacy pre-commit and commit-msg git hooks in this repo
Run path-privacy doctor on this repository to verify its commit gate
